instructions: How severe is this finding for end users of a payments app?
levels: Informational: style or preference, no runtime effect
Low: unlikely to cause a bug; cosmetic or defensive
Medium: can cause incorrect behaviour in some inputs or environments
High: security, data loss, money miscounted, or a crash on a common path

items.text: Variable `tmp` is never used in format_receipt()
Amounts are summed as floats before rounding in compute_total()
API key is logged at DEBUG level in http_client.request()
